snippet.title: Deep Space Miner - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🚀 Deep Space Miner launches on November 16!

Wishlist it on Steam  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4653390/Deep_Space_Miner/

Deep Space Miner is an incremental mining game where you mine alien ore, build specialized drones, and automate ore processing. Explore new worlds, defeat giant ore bosses, and prestige to unlock permanent upgrades.
